import math
import sys

def read_input(v, n):
    for _ in range(n):
        val = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        v.append(val)

def gcd_value(a, b):
    while a != 0:
        temp = b % a
        b = a
        a = temp
    return b

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    num, den, limit = map(int, input[:3])
    ratio = num / den
    min_diff = 1e9
    n, d = num, den
    for i in range(1, limit + 1):
        val = (num * i) / den
        floor_val = math.floor(val)
        ceil_val = math.ceil(val)
        rat_floor = floor_val / i
        rat_ceil = ceil_val / i
        diff_floor = abs(rat_floor - ratio)
        diff_ceil = abs(rat_ceil - ratio)
        if abs(diff_ceil - diff_floor) < 1e-15:
            if diff_ceil < min_diff:
                n = floor_val
                d = i
                min_diff = diff_ceil
        elif diff_ceil < diff_floor:
            if diff_ceil < min_diff:
                n = ceil_val
                d = i
                min_diff = diff_ceil
        else:
            if diff_floor < min_diff:
                n = floor_val
                d = i
                min_diff = diff_floor
    print(f"{n}/{d}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
